items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: I discovered her and told Chick about it and that's when Chick and -- what's his name? -- Al, anyway Chick took her over and he exploited her.

ctx.x: I discovered her and told Chick about it and that's when Chick and -- what's his name? -- Al, anyway Chick took her over and he exploited her. She became great.

And then we went -- we only stayed in the Harlem Opera House about three or four months and then we moved into the Apollo and see we had amateur night, see, and I used to rehearse everybody, get the key and everything.
